opening: I have a headache. I have one right now.
Each one lasts one or two hours.
I get occasional aches and pains. I take ibuprofen for them.
When I have the pain, it's a 9 out of 10.
Sometimes I feel nauseated when I'm in pain.
In college I had a similar headache.
My mother is alive and has migraines.
I'm working on a new project that I have to finish this month.

opening.text: I have a headache right now. It started two weeks ago and came on gradually. When I have the pain, it's a 9 out of 10, and it feels sharp and throbbing. Each one lasts one or two hours. Sometimes I feel nauseated when I'm in pain, and I vomited. I get occasional aches and pains and take ibuprofen for them. In college I had a similar headache. My mother is alive and has migraines. I'm working on a new project that I have to finish this month.
